concepts.title: 1. Classical Probability
concepts.subtitle: Equally likely outcomes
concepts.summary: When all outcomes are equally likely, theoretical probability is the ratio of favorable outcomes to total outcomes.

points.text: Count every outcome in the sample space before counting favorable outcomes.

concepts.trap: Using non-favorable outcomes as the numerator.

concepts.title: 2. Complementary Events
concepts.subtitle: The event does not happen
concepts.summary: An event and its complement together cover the full sample space, so their probabilities add to 1.

concepts.title: 3. Probability Bounds and Special Events
concepts.subtitle: Impossible, sure, and valid probabilities
concepts.summary: Every probability lies from 0 to 1 inclusive. Impossible events have probability 0 and sure events have probability 1.

points.text: Use $P(E)=0$ for impossible and $P(E)=1$ for sure events.

concepts.trap: Accepting a negative probability or a value greater than 1.

concepts.title: 4. Multi-Color Bag Selection
concepts.subtitle: Count favorable and total objects
concepts.summary: For a random selection from a bag with multiple colors or types, count all equally likely individual objects and the objects satisfying the event.

points.text: Total outcomes are all objects in the bag.

concepts.trap: Dividing by the number of colors instead of the number of objects.

schema_notes.strict_options_rule: Every strategy option and option_details text combines an instruction with actual numerical or mathematical content wrapped in single dollar signs.
schema_notes.latex_compliance: All probability equations, substitutions, calculations, and rubrics use multiline aligned LaTeX with at most one equals sign per line.
schema_notes.guided_calculation_compliance: Every step has exactly two vertically stacked outputs and every field placeholder is strictly Enter value; prompts and field labels do not leak answers or formula components.
schema_notes.pool_compliance: Each of the four typologies contains exactly 12 unique questions: 4 Easy, 4 Medium, 4 Hard.
schema_notes.svg_rule: Zero SVG topic: diagram_svg is intentionally omitted from all question objects.
schema_notes.topic_isolation: This topic is restricted to classical single-action probability, complements, bounds/special events, and multi-category one-selection probability; compound two-dice/coin/card-deck calculations belong to the next topic.
